nodes.chinese_ndef: 〔人群；士兵〕向〔某地；某人〕行进，前进；进攻

nodes.label: arrive
nodes.chinese_ndef: 〔人或车辆〕抵达〔某地〕；到达〔某地〕（尤指旅途的终点)

nodes.label: ascend
nodes.chinese_ndef: 垂直上行位移；移动、向上移动。（Oxford: To move upward, to fly, to soar.）

nodes.label: climb
nodes.chinese_ndef: 垂直上行位移；移动、向上移动。（Oxford: To ascend; rise; to go up.）

nodes.label: come
nodes.chinese_ndef: 来到；到达

nodes.label: cross
nodes.chinese_ndef: 穿过、跨越空间（研究者标注的原型义简述，完整释义待补）

nodes.label: descend
nodes.chinese_ndef: 垂直下行位移；移动、向下移动。（Oxford: To pass from a higher to a lower place; to move downwards; to come or go down in any way, for example by falling, flowing, walking, climbing etc.）

nodes.label: enter
nodes.chinese_ndef: 〔某人〕进入，进去〔某处〕

nodes.label: fall
nodes.chinese_ndef: 〔从高处〕落下；往下掉；降落

nodes.label: go
nodes.chinese_ndef: 去，走

nodes.label: plunge
nodes.chinese_ndef: 垂直下行位移；移动、向下移动。（Oxford: To fall or rush headlong into some thing, action, state or condition.）

nodes.label: return
nodes.chinese_ndef: 〔某人〕〔从某处〕返回〔另一处〕

nodes.label: rise
nodes.chinese_ndef: 垂直上行位移；移动、向上移动。（Oxford: To go up; to ascend; to climb.）

nodes.label: tumble
nodes.chinese_ndef: 垂直下行位移；移动、向下移动。（Oxford: To move or rush in a headlong or uncontrolled way.）
